name: NAVU
description: Integrate the NAVU.co sidebar into your website.
project_description:
This project is not affiliated with Navu in anyway! 

 That said, we would love it if they showed their support to Drupal by supporting us or Drupal. 

 The Navu Sidebar is an interactive AI guide designed to enhance user

engagement on your website.

 Features 
 
 Real-time AI Assistance: Offers answers to visitor questions without disrupting their browsing experience. 
 Search Functionality: Users can toggle to a search mode to find specific documents on the site. 
 Integration: Works seamlessly with existing tools like Slack and HubSpot. 
 Visitor Insights: Tracks behavior and interactions to aid in optimizing the website experience. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 Add the NAVU block to the pages you want and configure the site code.

You can add different blocks to different pages if you need something like that.

 Additional Requirements 
 Requires a subscription to navu.co
